text:
Maria: Hey finance — I paid for TSA PreCheck for our new hire Jenna on my personal card because the corp card declined at the kiosk. Charge was $85.00. I can't find the emailed receipt (didn't save it). Can I expense this and have it charged to the relocation budget? cc @Alex for approval.

Expense-bot: Hi Maria — quick note on policy: any missing receipt over $75 needs a Lost Receipt Form plus a bank/cc statement showing the charge. Please upload the statement and submit the Lost Receipt Form: https://redwood.finance/expenses/lost-receipt. Also add manager approval in the Concur comment.

Maria: I have a screenshot of the bank statement showing the $85 TSA PreCheck charge. Uploading now to Concur under "Lost receipts" and attaching the screenshot. Link (temp): https://imgur.com/abc123 (will attach properly in Concur).

Sam: Thanks — Finance here. When you submit, put "Relocation — new hire Jenna start 2026-04-05" in the manager comment. We'll need Alex (hiring manager) to explicitly approve the charge to relocation. Also please remove any PII from uploads.

Alex: Approved to charge relocation budget for Jenna's background/travel expenses. Alex: Approved 2026-03-22 for relocation.

Maria: Done — added the exact comment in Concur and attached the screenshot. Submitted expense ID EXP-4782. What else do you need from me?

Expense-bot: EXP-4782 received. Status: "awaiting finance review". Note: preliminary hold placed while team verifies manager approval and statement. Reimbursement timeline: 3-5 business days after review clears.

Sam: Looks good on our side. One note: please do NOT include passport numbers or other sensitive PII in the Concur upload or comments. For audit we just need the charge date, amount, and manager approval text. I'll mark EXP-4782 Approved and route for payment.

Maria: Great, thanks — really appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:

Alex: No problem — thanks for stepping in at the kiosk, Maria.

Expense-bot: Payment scheduled. Please allow up to 72 hours for payment to post to your bank account. If anything fails, we'll reopen the thread.
